items.title: Gucci Sales Disappoint on China Slump as Turnaround Falters
items.summary: Bloomberg reports Gucci's Q3 2026 comparable sales fell 6%, worse than the 3.3% decline analysts expected, with Kering failing to reiterate its 2026 return-to-growth guidance. Coverage notes the US market, which had been offsetting China weakness earlier in the year, has also lost momentum, undercutting Kering CEO Luca de Meo's turnaround narrative for institutional and retail investors in North America.

items.title: Kering ADRs slide 12% as Gucci sales fall 6% despite in-line group revenue
items.summary: Kering shares (and US-traded ADRs) dropped about 12% after Q3 2026 results showed Gucci revenue down 4% reported / 6% comparable to EUR1.29 billion, with direct-retail sales down 9%. North America was called Gucci's 'most resilient' market with improved conversion and ticket size, but wholesale's 45% jump came off a depressed prior-year base, tempering the positive read for US investors.

items.title: Gucci sales fell 6% as Kering raises store-closure target to at least 125
items.summary: RetailBoss (Substack-style aggregator, cross-checked against the Bloomberg/Investing.com primary wires above) reports Kering raised its full-year 2026 net store-closure target to at least 125 after already closing 105 net locations through September, with North America's most resilient-market framing offset by continued footprint cuts. Figures corroborated against T1 wires per source-pool verification_required handling.

items.title: Borbonese names Gucci veteran Marie-Laure Lequain as CEO

items.title: Earnings call transcript: Kering Q3 2026 shares sink as Gucci recovery lags
items.summary: Transcript coverage of Kering's Q3 call: Gucci comparable sales fell 6%, shares sank, and management pointed to early turnaround signals while the recovery lagged expectations.

items.title: Kering struggles through another quarter as Gucci sales fall 6%
items.summary: Gucci Q3 revenue EUR 1.29bn, down 6% comparable; directly operated store sales fell 9% (about 3 points worse than consensus) while wholesale rose. Bernstein's Solca read it as weak underlying appeal for Gucci's core products; management cited higher average transaction value and conversion as early positives.

items.title: Weekly Recap: Q3 revenue flat, Gucci comps down and Luca de Meo margin plan
items.summary: Weekly recap: Gucci owned-store sales down about 9%, Kering accelerating store closures toward 125 net, RBC notes wholesale offset weaker retail, and scrutiny of Demna's creative direction as he nears one year in the role. No US-specific figures given.
